summary.intent: Execute Phase 24 (bug fixes + test infrastructure) for cipher-box, review and clean up the resulting code, get it merged via PR, and fix the recovery E2E test that was failing in CI.
summary.outcome: Phase 24 was executed successfully (3 plans, 9 commits), code reviewed and simplified, PR #361 merged. A series of follow-on PRs (#363, #364, #365) were opened to fix the recovery E2E test in CI, which is still iterating — the root cause was IPNS records being published via mock-ipns-routing (not Kubo DHT), requiring the browser to reach the mock directly with CORS enabled.

repo: IPNS records in CI are published via mock-ipns-routing (port 3001), NOT through Kubo's DHT. Kubo's gateway (8080) and API (5001) cannot resolve these names — only mock-ipns-routing and the CipherBox DB cache can.
The CipherBox API's /ipns/resolve endpoint requires JWT auth (JwtAuthGuard on entire IpnsController) — it cannot be used by unauthenticated tools like recovery.html.

recovery.html resolveIpns fallback chain: (1) /ipns/ HEAD on IPFS gateway → (2) /routing/v1/ipns/ delegated routing with retries → (3) localhost:3000/ipns/resolve API → (4) Kubo API POST /api/v0/name/resolve. Chain silently fails if all 4 fail.
Web E2E workflow was missing SDK_E2E_SECRET env var — recovery spec uses createTestAccount from SDK harness which reads this var; API uses TEST_LOGIN_SECRET. Both are 'e2e-test-secret-ci-only' in CI.
Kubo in CI has no CORS headers configured by default — browser cannot make cross-origin requests to localhost:8080 or localhost:5001 from the Vite dev server at localhost:5173.
computeIpHash() already existed in apps/web/src/lib/device/info.ts — useAuth.ts was inlining 7 lines of SHA-256 code unnecessarily.

DeviceRegistry was upgraded from v1 to v2 schema in this phase — v1->v2 migration added with lenient read and validateV2Registry. Only empty-string ipHash should be auto-healed; other malformed values should be rejected.
publishWithVerify was re-publishing on every retry — should publish once then retry only the verification step.

code.finding: publishWithVerify: publish should happen once; retries should only re-run verification, not re-publish. Original code re-published on each retry.
validateRegistryShape() helper deduplicates v1/v2 validation. TypeScript doesn't propagate narrowing across function boundaries — cast obj.devices as unknown[] after the call.

let cid declared inside try block was inaccessible in finally block. Must be hoisted above try. Use string | undefined with localized ! assertions at usage sites, not definite assignment at declaration.
Mock IPNS routing server (Fastify) had no CORS headers — browser recovery tool couldn't reach it. Added Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * with GET + OPTIONS methods only.
IPNS_GATEWAY should default to DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL (mock-ipns-routing at :3001), not the CipherBox API. All env vars should use .trim() || default pattern.

resolveIpns API fallback uses window.location.origin.replace(/:d+$/, ':3000') — works correctly but requires API to not have auth on the resolve endpoint (it does, causing silent 401 failure in fallback chain).
After auto-repair change, fresh bin loadBin returns sequenceNumber: 1 (not 0) because it publishes immediately on first load.

workflow: GSD wave-based parallel execution: 3 agents ran concurrently, each with fresh 200k context. Orchestrator stays at ~10-15% context. Spot-checks (SUMMARY.md exists + git commits present) validate success.
classifyHandoffIfNeeded CI bug: agent reports 'failed' but this is a Claude Code runtime bug firing after tool calls complete. Spot-checks determine real success/failure.
Code review agents (reuse/quality/efficiency) run in parallel on the full diff — effective pattern for post-execution cleanup.
Stale package .d.ts files caused 6 type errors in the web app — rebuilding @cipherbox/crypto and @cipherbox/api-client resolved them without code changes.
Recovery E2E debugging required downloading Playwright artifacts (error-context.md) since GitHub API was intermittently unreachable for log streaming.

PR merge conflicts in planning files (.planning/ROADMAP.md, STATE.md, REQUIREMENTS.md, PROJECT.md) are common when two phase branches are merged close together — both phases' completions must be preserved.

friction: GitHub API was intermittently unreachable during CI debugging, requiring multiple retries and relying on artifact downloads instead of log streaming.
Recovery E2E test required 3 separate PRs (#363, #364, #365) to debug — each revealed a new layer: missing env var → CORS → auth-gated API → mock-ipns-routing not reachable.
TypeScript doesn't propagate narrowing from helper validation functions to callers — required explicit casts (as unknown[]) after calling validateRegistryShape().
Background bash tasks failing with exit code 128 (push already done by foreground command) created noisy notifications.
Kubo CORS must be configured after container starts via ipfs config commands — not configurable via Docker Compose service definition directly.
The recovery.html fallback chain silently swallows all errors and shows a generic 'Failed to resolve IPNS name' — makes debugging CI failures time-consuming.
open_items: Recovery E2E test (PR #365) is still iterating in CI — CORS added to mock-ipns-routing, but test has not yet passed green.

recovery.html IPNS resolution uses the CipherBox API as a fallback but the endpoint requires JWT auth — recovery tool can never use this path. Should either add an unauthenticated /ipns/resolve endpoint or document the limitation.
Local development of the recovery E2E test requires Kubo CORS configured on the Docker host (192.168.133.12) — currently blocked without running ipfs config commands manually on the VM.
byo-file-workload.ts: pre-existing type errors (unrelated to phase 24) were fixed as a side effect but the underlying architecture (cid/pinSize scoping around try/finally) is fragile.
Integration tests in packages/sdk that require a live API (2 tests) are always skipped locally — these are never run unless CI is triggered.
